core: Presynaptic calcium and membrane potential control of transmission
qualifier: inhibitory GABAergic synapse assembly (gephyrin, GABA receptor clustering)
name: Presynaptic calcium control and inhibitory synapse assembly
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic depolarization, calcium channels, GIRK and vesicle release at synapses, and unlike the confusables (which add AMPA/kainate and glutamate secretion) they include GABA receptor/gephyrin clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import
rationale: All members concern targeting and import of proteins into the peroxisome matrix or membrane, whereas the confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid and ether lipid metabolism.

core: PD-L1 regulation and T cell antitumor response
name: PD-L1 regulation including ALK-STAT3-driven transcription
rationale: Members cover PD-L1 transcription, glycosylation, trafficking and degradation plus T cell responses to tumor, and the ALK/STAT3 nuclear events and PD-L1 transcription separate it from neddylation- and degradation-centred confusables.

name: RHOQ-driven GLUT4 translocation and glucose import
rationale: Members concern moving GLUT4 to the plasma membrane to import glucose (with adiponectin secretion in adipocytes), and the RHOQ cycle and protein targeting to membrane distinguish it from the insulin-receptor signaling confusables.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics and PKR/arsenite stress
name: AU-rich mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins that stabilize or destabilize mRNAs and repress translation, and the stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite response members distinguish it from mRNA decay confusables.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism with ADA and PNP defects
rationale: All members concern metabolism or catabolism of deoxyribonucleosides and deoxyribonucleotides, and the ADA/PNP defects and deoxy- rather than ribo-nucleoside focus separate it from purine ribonucleoside and pyrimidine biosynthesis confusables.

name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin signaling to MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NGF-TRKA and NT3-TRKC receptor signaling with their effectors, and the ERK5, p38, MAPK6/4 and RAS-MAPK members distinguish it from the TRKB/BDNF and p75NTR confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ and PDGF receptor signaling regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ transcriptional control and cell density sensing in fibroblasts with regulation of PDGF and FGF receptor signaling, which separates it from TGF-beta, AP-2 and stromal confusables.

qualifier: ligand secretion (PORCN) and non-canonical calcium branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis, Golgi trafficking and secretion, receptor-level activation and the Wnt/Ca2+ and WNT5A branch, distinguishing it from destruction-complex, Hedgehog lipidation and blood-barrier confusables.

name: Gluconeogenic substrate metabolism: fructose, glycerol and alanine
rationale: Members concern fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, distinct from glycolysis, glucokinase, galactose and pentose confusables.

name: HPA axis stress response and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members span CRH response, corticotropin and cortisol secretion, corticosterone response and stress/fear behavior, combining hormone secretion (absent from behavioral confusables) with the stress response (absent from glucocorticoid-signaling confusable).

qualifier: podocyte filtration barrier and brush border microvilli
name: Podocyte and brush-border epithelial polarity and junctions
rationale: Members concern apical-basal polarity, tight junctions and microvilli together with podocyte/nephrin and glomerular basement membrane biology, distinguishing it from glomerular vascular/mesangial and apical-trafficking confusables.

name: Replication stress and DNA topological processing
rationale: Members concern replication initiation, fork reversal, R-loops and responses to hydroxyurea and camptothecin with DNA topological change, unlike the telomere, checkpoint and transcription-termination confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell antigen presentation and protozoan response
name: Dendritic cell-primed Th1 immunity to protozoa
rationale: Members link activated dendritic cells, IL-12 and GM-CSF production to IFN-gamma Th1 responses, and the DC antigen-presentation and protozoan-response members distinguish it from Th1-differentiation and NKT confusables.

name: Calcium-stimulated adenylyl cyclase signaling to CREB
rationale: All members concern adenylyl cyclase-generated cAMP driving CREB activity, distinguishing it from the CaMK-to-CREB, generic cAMP/PKA and synaptic plasticity confusables.

name: Fibrotic repair: myofibroblast differentiation and matrix assembly
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, connective tissue replacement, collagen metabolism and ECM assembly, unlike confusables centred on fibroblast migration/apoptosis, TGF-beta or collagen biosynthesis.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
name: FGFR splice-isoform ligand binding, mutant activation and signaling
rationale: All members are FGFR1-4 activation and adaptor cascades, and the b/c isoform-specific ligand binding, Klotho co-receptors and activating mutants distinguish it from Sprouty/PI3K-focused FGFR and other RTK confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are activation cycles of RHOA, RHOB, RHOC, CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG, distinguishing it from confusables built on RAC, RHOD/F, RHOU/V or RND GTPases and their effectors.

qualifier: clathrin coat dynamics and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and receptor trafficking
rationale: Members concern synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling via clathrin coat assembly/disassembly plus endocytic trafficking of postsynaptic receptors, unlike confusables on vesicle docking/fusion or Rab/ARF signaling.

core: Epithelial solute carrier transport and inherited defects
qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption and carbohydrate digestion
name: Intestinal and renal hexose, urate and amino acid transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated epithelial transport of sugars, urate, cystine and imino acids with their deficiency diseases, and the hexose absorption and dietary carbohydrate digestion members distinguish it from amino acid and organic cation transporter confusables.

core: Myeloid leukocyte chemotaxis and chemokine production
qualifier: formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling
name: Myeloid chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors and chemokines
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil, monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis and CCL/CXCL chemokine production via formyl peptide and complement receptors, unlike confusables centred on degranulation, respiratory burst, extravasation or DC cytokines.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Adipocyte lipid droplet formation, triglyceride storage and lipophagy
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown by lipophagy, triglyceride and phospholipid storage regulation and adipogenesis, distinguishing it from LXR, lipolysis, beta-oxidation and glycerolipid synthesis confusables.

core: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin receptor signaling
qualifier: proximal PLCG1, PI3K, RAS and STAT3 effectors
name: TRKA and TRKC receptor activation and proximal effectors
rationale: Members are NGF-TRKA and NT3-TRKC activation and their immediate PLCG1, PI3K, RAS, STAT3 and ARMS effectors, lacking the downstream ERK5/p38/CREB members of one confusable and the p75NTR members of another.

qualifier: proprioception, posture and Purkinje cell layer
name: Neural control of locomotion, posture and proprioception
rationale: Six members concern walking, righting reflex, voluntary movement, proprioception and cerebellar Purkinje layer formation (the neuronal RNA-binding module fits only through its neural context), and proprioception/voluntary movement separate it from exploratory, cerebellar-granule, vocal and glycinergic confusables.

name: Platelet activation via ADP P2Y receptors and GPVI
rationale: Members are platelet activation cascades through ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, GPVI and LDL sensitization, distinguishing it from adhesion/aggregation/degranulation confusables and from thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling.
